title: Ecology SpeciesAreaIsland

stats.done_summary: Successfully completed the island biogeography research task. Analyzed species-area relationship using island_species.csv data. Fitted power-law models (S=cA^z) with z=0.210-0.220. Identified two outlier islands with exceptional conservation value. Generated comprehensive visualizations and derived conservation implications: 50% habitat loss leads to ~14% species loss; preserving 90% of species requires ~61% of original area. Produced full research report with methodology, results, figures, and discussion.
